deskyard login: sign in to a server, approving in the browser

Usage: deskyard [-e ENV] login URL [OPTIONS]

Signs this CLI in to a Deskyard server: prints a code and an approval URL (on
stderr) and opens it in your browser, where you check the code and approve
while signed in to Deskyard. Then saves the server, your username and a client
credential for this machine in servers.json ($XDG_CONFIG_HOME/deskyard,
default ~/.config/deskyard; mode 0600). With an environment in the URL
(https://host/alice) it becomes the server's default environment, once checked
that you have full access to it; without one, your only environment does. The
first server becomes the default. The request expires after 10 minutes.

Arguments:
  URL        string      required  the server's address, optionally with an environment: https://host or https://host/alice

Options:
  --name NAME          local name for the server, used with -e NAME/ENV
                       (default: its host name)
  --no-browser         only print the approval URL, don't open a browser

Prints: a confirmation with the account and environment; the code and approval
  URL on stderr

Examples:
  deskyard login https://deskyard.example.com/alice
  deskyard login https://deskyard.example.com --name work --no-browser

Where: on this machine, talking to the server
Exit codes: 0 ok, 1 error, 2 usage error
